transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to get the operating plan for next month's evening student theater showcase finalized so we can move forward with ticket sales. As a reminder, the routine process is that the theater teacher provides a technical report, the facilities coordinator provides a safety report, and then I record and sign the operating plan. I understand the auditorium is our usual venue with a 300-person capacity, and the gym is available as an alternate space if needed. Let's work through the reports and get this wrapped up today.

transcript.text: I need to flag an important update before we finalize anything. I received the updated fire-safety certificate after a facilities inspection this week, and it has not yet been circulated with the event packet. The current certificate limits this event to exactly 180 audience members — not 300 — and requires exactly two aisles, each at least 6 feet wide. We'll need to adjust our capacity planning accordingly before the operating plan can be signed.
